# Task intake

Understand the request before changing code in this repository. Find the existing implementation and patterns in the codebase before you edit. Inspect callers when the change touches shared interfaces or public APIs. Identify tests that cover the behavior you will change before implementing. Do not start editing when the task still needs investigation and discovery work in the codebase.

Load detailed steps from references when needed.
